subject: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics

Hi Laura / Vivek —

Quick ask: BrightWave (Maya Patel) is requesting an elevated PLG credit grant to accelerate a POC that will run heavy embedding/semantic search workloads. Current self-serve tier gives them $5k; they are asking for a one-time $50k promotional credit to be issued up front so they can complete a production-scale eval and sign an enterprise contract.

Why I recommend approval:
- Deal stage: strong PLG signals (10 dev seats, 3 apps using embeddings) + active exec sponsor (CTO).
- Expected ARR on conversion: $320k ARR in first 12 months (per Aditya).
- Time-sensitive: procurement wants a credit grant in writing by Friday to move forward.

Attached is a short worksheet with usage forecast and proposed amortization schedule (promo_credit_request.xlsx). I’m requesting leadership sign-off for a one-time $50,000 credit to be issued via self-serve promo link (see related link).

Proposed conditions:
- Credits expire 12 months 
- Auto-conversion to paid only for usage above free credit; credits do not change billing terms
- Track via deal ID BW-2026-0897 and tag in HubSpot

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want a walkthrough.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics

Karthik —

Thanks for the write-up and the worksheet. A couple clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Is $50k the minimum required for their POC to be meaningful, or can we structure a staged release (e.g., $20k now / $30k on milestones)?
2) Are there precedents for this size of grant in the last 12 months? If yes, please attach the approver and outcome.
3) What KPIs will we track over the next 60 days to validate progress (tokens used, endpoints, latency SLAs)?

Stephanie — can you flag any finance/recognition constraints? Vivek — looping you as this is above the standard sales promo threshold.

-Laura
Laura Bennett | VP Revenue Operations
laura@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics

Adding context from the field — I spoke with Maya this morning. Key points:
- $50k is their ask because they want to run full dataset embeddings (approx 1B tokens) + 3-week stress test on a real query workload. They’ll likely run out of the standard $5k quickly.
- Their procurement team has a calendar constraint: they need a written credit commitment to keep the engagement on the board for the week.
- Conversion probability: high; CTO said they forecast signing by Q3 if POC demonstrates 95% recall + sub-300ms median latency.

Staged release is reasonable. Suggestion: issue $25k now, and a conditional $25k upon hitting milestone: 30M tokens consumed and a short QA doc from their engineering lead. That reduces our upfront exposure and keeps momentum.

HubSpot link to deal and notes: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2345678

-Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics

Thanks team — finance checks here. Notes:
- We can accommodate a promo grant up to $50k but prefer staged releases for revenue recognition and risk management.
- Proposed accounting: amortize credits over 12 months against COGS as promo expense; record a promotional adjustment line on the first invoice.
- I attached the standard approval routing and thresholds (approval_matrix.pdf). For grants >$25k we need VP sign-off (Laura) and an exec (Vivek) to acknowledge.

If you go staged ($25k/$25k): please include milestone criteria in HubSpot and attach engineering acceptance notes to the deal record.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Finance Ops Manager
stephanie@redwood.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to issue $50k PLG promotional credits to BrightWave Analytics

Thanks for the clear threading. I’m comfortable approving a staged approach: issue $25,000 immediately and hold the second $25,000 contingent on the milestone Aditya outlined (30M tokens consumed + engineering sign-off). Conditions:
- Promo expires 12 months from issuance.
- Add clause to HubSpot that credits are non-transferable and do not change pricing terms.
- Sales to notify CS and Solutions so they can prioritize the POC and confirm acceptance criteria.

Karthik — please proceed with the staged issuance and update the deal with the milestone & acceptance checklist. Once updated, Finance will process the promo issuance.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | CEO, Redwood Inference

1) Issue $25k via self-serve promo link: https://console.redwood.ai/promo/issue/BW-2026-0897 (processing now).
